headline: Govt hires law firm to seek Benazir Ahmed's return from UAE
summary: The Bangladesh government has appointed a legal team to cancel the bail of former IGP Benazir Ahmed in Dubai to facilitate his repatriation.
details: The Bangladesh government has appointed a specialized law firm to seek the cancellation of former Inspector General of Police (IGP) Benazir Ahmed's bail in the UAE.
Home Minister Humaiun Kobir stated that the legal process has been initiated to bring the former police chief back to Bangladesh to face charges.
State Minister for Foreign Affairs Shama Obaid confirmed that it is expected Benazir Ahmed will be repatriated to the country soon.
The move comes amid ongoing efforts to ensure the former IGP faces legal proceedings in Bangladesh following his departure to the UAE.
The government is working closely with UAE authorities to ensure the legal requirements for his return are met.
caption:
The Bangladesh government has hired a law firm to cancel Benazir Ahmed's bail in Dubai and bring him home.

The Bangladesh government has appointed a specialized law firm to seek the cancellation of former Inspector General of Police (IGP) Benazir Ahmed's bail in the UAE.

Home Minister Humaiun Kobir stated that the legal process has been initiated to bring the former police chief back to Bangladesh to face charges.

State Minister for Foreign Affairs Shama Obaid confirmed that it is expected Benazir Ahmed will be repatriated to the country soon.

The move comes amid ongoing efforts to ensure the former IGP faces legal proceedings in Bangladesh following his departure to the UAE.

The government is working closely with UAE authorities to ensure the legal requirements for his return are met.

Source: Prothom Alo, Dhaka Tribune, Somoy News, Jamuna TV

headline: LPG price rises by Tk70: 12kg cylinder now Tk1,598 for August
summary: The Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission (BERC) has increased the price of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) effective from the evening.
details: The Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission (BERC) has raised the price of 12kg LPG cylinders by Tk70 for the month of August.
The new price for a 12kg cylinder is now set at Tk1,598, effective from the evening of the announcement.
The price hike comes as a result of adjustments in the international market prices of LPG.
Political parties, including Jamaat-e-Islami, have voiced their concern over the sudden increase in fuel costs for consumers.
caption:
Your cooking gas just got more expensive. A 12kg LPG cylinder now costs Tk1,598.

The Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission (BERC) has raised the price of 12kg LPG cylinders by Tk70 for the month of August.

The new price for a 12kg cylinder is now set at Tk1,598, effective from the evening of the announcement.

The price hike comes as a result of adjustments in the international market prices of LPG.

Political parties, including Jamaat-e-Islami, have voiced their concern over the sudden increase in fuel costs for consumers.
